features.name: Big Integer Field Migration
features.description: A new compiler and runtime feature in Business Central version 29 that allows changing an existing table field from integer to big integer without considering it a destructive change, with automatic SQL column updates.
caveats: Compiler warnings for code that might narrow or overflow big integer values
Table relations pointing to integer fields need to be updated
Cannot reverse migration back to integer without destructive steps
Only migrate fields that genuinely need 64-bit capacity

features.name: AL Compiler Validation for Integer to BigInteger Conversion
features.description: The AL compiler validates field type changes from integer to big integer when targeted at runtime 18.0 or later, allowing this conversion without treating it as destructive.
caveats: Only available for runtime 18.0 and later

features.name: App Source Cop Warnings for BigInteger Dependencies
features.description: The compiler and app source cop now warn when dependent code might narrow or overflow big integer values, protecting against overflow scenarios.
caveats: Warnings available for app source extensions
PTE code cop warnings not fully available in preview version tested
Warnings for table relations may not be complete in this release

features.name: Runtime Schema Synchronization for BigInteger
features.description: The runtime schema synchronization service automatically converts SQL columns from int to big int without data loss when field type is changed.
caveats: Version 28 deployment fails with destructive change error
Version 29 accepts the change without destructive change warning

features.name: Compiler Narrowing Conversion Detection
features.description: The compiler in Version 29 detects and warns about narrowing conversions when biginteger values are assigned to integer fields, preventing runtime overflow errors.
caveats: Compiler warnings for related fields and calc formulas not yet present in preview

features.name: No Upgrade Codeunit Required for Integer to BigInteger Migration
features.description: Migration of fields from integer to biginteger does not require an upgrade codeunit. The platform handles data conversion and related record updates automatically.

features.name: Runtime Version 18.0 Requirement for BigInteger Support
features.description: Integer to biginteger migration requires target runtime version 18.0 or later. Extensions must update their runtime version to support this change.
caveats: Customers with runtime below 18.0 cannot perform this migration until runtime is updated

features.name: Irreversibility of BigInteger to Integer Conversion
features.description: Once a field is migrated from integer to biginteger, conversion back to integer requires destructive migration steps including moving data to separate table, emptying the table, and moving data back.
caveats: Reverse migration is destructive and complex
